name: Ládbesenyő (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Ládbesenyő: a blue shield with a stag, with a helm and red and white mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ládbesenyő arms with helm, mantling and scroll
